title: pica-nest package job
description: packages/<mgr>/<id>/build.json — where the payload comes from and which arches to build. Validated by `python3 -m ci.nest validate`; this schema is for editor completion.

matrix.description: OpenWrt architectures to build, each one artifact per target. Keys of `platforms` in ci/config.json; `all` for arch-independent packages.

upstream.description: For url/archive sources with a pinned pkgver: where `nest bump` looks for new releases.

arch_map.description: Matrix arch -> the name upstream uses in its URL or asset (x86_64 -> amd64).

packages.description: Feed package names to bundle, resolved through the feed index per arch.

optional.description: Names bundled when the feed has them, skipped otherwise.

version_from.description: Which package's feed version becomes pkgver when the manifest has none. Default: the first of `packages`.

tag.description: Exact tag, may use {version} (e.g. v{version}). Omit to take the newest release.

tag_regex.description: Take the newest release whose tag matches.

prerelease.description: Consider pre-releases when no exact tag is given.

match.description: Regex for the asset name; {version} is substituted; one capture group = the arch.

unzip.description: The asset is a zip: extract members whose name matches this regex.

url.description: Archive or bare file per arch; {arch}, {platform}, {version} are substituted.

rename.description: Name for the single resulting file (made executable).

dest.description: Directory under root/ to place the files in.
